Yet the traces consistently report a confident pass based on a mug to the right of the headphones. The edited image also shows a second mug left of the headphones and a blurred blue mug-like region; the right-hand mug supports the requested relation, but the traces do not establish whether it is the original mug or whether the edit is complete. Since the instruction asks to move the mug and the reference is partial, do not infer completeness from the right-side relation alone or treat the reference label as atomic ground truth. Repair the binding to resolve the image placeholder and identify the relevant objects using source-to-edited correspondence; make the criterion assess requested progress/completion and preserve unknown when identity or evidence is ambiguous. Keep this semantic issue separate from transport/schema failures: all traces are valid, queried, and dependency-free.
